checks.observation: The audit rejects missing declarations, non-theorems, non-propositions and transitively collected axioms outside propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. A conditional theorem can pass this audit while still requiring I(27); the manuscript says so. Theorem 1 supplies distinct degree-twenty centers and no cooccurrence, with the remaining degree cap derived internally. These are actual hypotheses, not extra axioms or a hidden support cutoff.
checks.scope: Classical axiom policy versus ordinary theorem premises

checks.method: Diffed the exact round-3 and round-4 manuscript bytes, then checked the replacement paragraph against Theorems 1–3, Corollary 4 and the formal dependency chain.
checks.observation: The only prose change replaces the overly broad statement about successful proofs with an explicit account: local arguments retain I(27) where stated; Corollary 4 additionally uses the external enumerative theorem; the exploratory calculations are not proof premises. This wording supports the stated method without implying that the ordinary corollary is independent of enumeration. Same-evaluator and independent-certification limits remain disclosed.

content.summary: The methods preserve the exact proof hypotheses and distinguish checking a conditional theorem from proving its antecedent. The revised Section 6 now consistently separates the local structural arguments, their explicit I(27) premise, the external enumerative input to Corollary 4, and exploratory diagnostics. No required revision.
